senses.gloss:
m. (-टः)
A servant, a slave.
f. (-टी)
A female servant.
E.
चिट to serve, affix अण्, also with कन् added चेटक. f. चेटिका; also चेड, &c.

m. (-कः)
1 A slave.
2 A gallant: see the last.
3 A servant, a minister, one who fulfils an appointed duty.
E.
चिट to serve, ण्वुल affix, or चेट with कन् added.
